title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers: Membership Tenure Months on Reinstatement
content:
**Rule.** The reinstated term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers counts membership-tenure months. These depend on how long before the reinstatement date the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program was enrolled, measured in whole calendar months:

- **2 months** when the Summit membership was enrolled at least 120 whole calendar months before the reinstatement date;
- **1 month** when it was enrolled at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole calendar months before;
- **none** when it was enrolled fewer than 60 whole calendar months before.

## Questions on the rule

**Which record decides the months?**
The enrolment date of the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, compared with the reinstatement date.

**What is a whole calendar month here?**
A month counts only once the same day of the month has been reached. From 15 March of one year, 120 whole calendar months have passed on 15 March ten years later. On 14 March ten years later only 119 have passed.

**What happens exactly on 120 or 60 months?**
Each figure counts as reached. Exactly 120 whole months gives 2 months, and exactly 60 whole months gives 1 month.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical enrolment on 15 March 2016)

| Reinstatement date | Whole calendar months since enrolment | Membership-tenure months |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2026 | 120 | 2 |
| 14 March 2026 | 119 | 1 |
| 15 March 2021 | 60 | 1 |
| 14 March 2021 | 59 | none |
